name: Вокзал. Петергоф.
description:
Здание вокзала было построено в 1855—1857 годах по проекту архитектора Н. Л. Бенуа на деньги барона фон Штиглица. Общая планировка наружной части вокзала представляет собой уменьшенную копию католического собора итальянского города Орвието, в реставрации которого Бенуа принимал участие в 1843 году.

Первоначально железная дорога из Петербурга заканчивалась внутри здания вокзала, но позже, при продолжении путей в сторону Ораниенбаума, западная стена здания была разобрана.

С 2010 года здание вокзала не используется, построены новые пассажирские павильоны, работают автоматизированная система контроля оплаты проезда с турникетами и касса по продаже железнодорожных билетов дальнего следования. Есть зал ожидания.

name: Tufted capuchin
description:
3D scan of a skull of tufted capuchin (*Sapajus apella*). 


The tufted capuchin is a New World primate from South America and the Caribbean islands of Trinidad and Margarita and it is one of the most widespread primates in the Neotropics. It has a head-body length of 32 to 57 centimetres and a tail length of 38 to 56 centimetres. It lives in many different kinds of environment, including moist tropical and subtropical forest, dry forest, and disturbed or secondary forest; it has an omnivorous diet, mostly feeding on fruits and invertebrates, although it sometimes feeds on small vertebrates (e.g. lizards and bird chicks) and other plant parts. 


Specimen: Tufted capuchin, *Sapajus apella* Linnaeus, 1758

name: "1993" Jurassic Park Original Stegosaurus
description:
Jurassic Park Series 1 Stegosaurus figure, released by Kenner in 1993. This figure was part of the original wave of toys based on the blockbuster "Jurassic Park" movie. The Stegosaurus figure is notable for its "Dino-Damage" wound feature, which allowed a piece of its flesh to be removed, revealing a wound beneath—a common feature among the toys in this line to simulate injuries. Additionally, it features a "Whip-Action Spiked Tail," where pulling the tail back would cause it to spring forward, mimicking the tail's defensive action.

This Stegosaurus toy stands approximately 7 inches tall and was designed to be suitable for children aged 4 and up. It was released with a unique UPC code of 0 76281 61014 6, making it identifiable among collectors and enthusiasts​ (Dino Toy Blog)​​ (Shop OB Toys)​​ (Figure Realm)​.

name: Sythera - Amphibious Variant
description:
A high-detail alien creature concept designed to inhabit dense tropical rainforests and the surrounding freshwater ecosystems on an extraterrestrial world.

This model was sculpted from scratch as a creature design study, with a focus on believable anatomy, intricate surface detail, and a distinctive silhouette. It was then retopologised in Autodesk Maya to create an animation-friendly low-poly mesh, with textures baked from the high-poly sculpt and painted in Substance 3D Painter.

This project is intended as a portfolio piece showcasing digital sculpting, creature design, retopology, texture baking, and 3D modelling skills.

Software used:

Autodesk Mudbox - Autodesk Maya - Substance Painter

name: Giganotosaurus carolinii
description:
Giganotosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur that lived in what is now Argentina, during the early Cenomanian age of the Late Cretaceous period, approximately 99.6 to 95 million years ago. The holotype specimen was discovered in the Candeleros Formation of Patagonia in 1993 and is almost 70% complete. The animal was named Giganotosaurus carolinii in 1995; the genus name translates to "giant southern lizard", and the specific name honors the discoverer, Ruben Carolini. A dentary bone, a tooth, and some tracks, discovered before the holotype, were later assigned to this animal. The genus attracted much interest and became part of a scientific debate about the maximum sizes of theropod dinosaurs.

![](https://i.redd.it/2025-giganotosaurus-carolinii-skeletal-by-dan-folkes-v0-y0rbxdb1teee1.jpg?width=1500&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=12506544da6e03a06a7193254edc868ffeb8a0c5)

name: Etruscan seal (right navicular)
description:
3D scan of the right navicular of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

Euoplocephalus, a herbivorous dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period, marches into the prehistoric scene as a heavily armored ankylosaurid. This dinosaur, known for its tank-like appearance, was equipped with an impressive array of bony plates and spikes, providing it with formidable protection against predators.

Characterized by a low-slung body, a broad tail club, and a covering of bony armor called osteoderms, Euoplocephalus was a quadrupedal herbivore. Its tail club, in particular, was a defensive weapon, possibly used to fend off predators or intruders.

name: Fossil brown bear (first phalanx)
description:
3D scan of the first phalanx of a fossil brown bear (*Ursus arctos*). 


Fossil of a prime adult female skull of brown bear. The specimen was found in "Abisso Oriano Coltelli" cave (44°05'35,0 N, 10°14'47,0" E, labelled T/Lu 642 in the Tuscan register of caves) which opens at 1209 m a.s.l on the western slope of "Monte Alto di Sella" (Apuan Alps). The mammal assemblage collected consists of 486 investigated specimens, 127 of which belong to an individual skeleton of brown bear. The bear died from non-violent causes, probably during hibernation. The specimen was dated providing a conventional age of 6480 ± 40 14 C ka BP (Holocene).
More information : https://amq.aiqua.it/index.php/amq/article/view/112



Specimen: Brown bear, *Ursus arctos* Linnaeus, 1758

Inventory number: I17771

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

description:
The ground beetle (Carabus nemoralis) is a common and predatory insect found in a wide range of habitats, including gardens, forests, and fields. The Black British Shorthair, a variant of the British Shorthair, originated in the UK. These cats descend from Roman domestic cats, evolving over centuries. Black British Shorthairs are calm, affectionate, and low-maintenance. They're prone to obesity and should be monitored for heart and kidney issues. Their lifespan is typically 14-20 years. name: Pale Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

The Pale Blight Drone is a *Beetle Rubigenum Drone* that uses it's light grey hue to blend in with the rocks and minerals in it's environment. It's main occupation within the hive is to find food in the form of minerals - such as Calcium and Quartz - and transport them to the hive's storage rooms, or to the Queen herself for her to eat. 

**Other Things to Note:** *Pale Drones consume rocks whole, making them rather slow during digestion. As a geovore, it is mostly non-hostile.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Pale Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pale-blight-queen-61cf19ab28224a199ded284a98f09ce0)

name: Barrel Mimic
description:
Model has been created with Blender©. Textures were made and baked using Adobe Substance Painter.

This is a model of an unusual mimic design.
Mimics are typically portrayed as furniture hiding a creature inside, but this concept takes a different approach.

Here, the mimic takes the form of a barrel with a mechanical entity concealed within. Through the broken wooden planks, a metal hand reinforced with wooden plates emerges from the darkness, gripping an axe.

At the front, a larger opening reveals the creature’s eyes, adding to its unsettling presence.

description:
**Please read before downloading:**

● This model is released under the CC-BY-SA license. Attribution and share-alike are required.

● I encourage respectful and positive use of this content, in line with responsible and ethical practices.

● The model is based on literature and not direct observation, so inaccuracies may exist.



**Literature-Based Visual Representation of First Zoea of *Palaemon Pugio***

This 3D model is a scientifically informed representation of the first zoea larval stage of *Palaemon Pugio*, meticulously crafted based on BROAD, A. C. in 1957, titled “Larval Development of *Palaemonetes Pugio* Holthuis”, published in the *Biological Bulletin* (Vol. 112, pp. 144-161). Designed as a valuable educational and research tool, it serves marine biologists, educators, and enthusiasts, providing a detailed view of the larval stage. While striving for accuracy, I acknowledge the potential for errors and warmly welcome any corrections or insights to enhance the model’s fidelity.

name: ヘナタリ / Pirenella nipponica
description:
砂泥の干潟に棲む長さが3～4㎝くらいの細長い巻貝。この貝のフタがいろいろな香料を混ぜ合わせて作る「練り香」の材料の1つで、漢字では「甲香」と書く。房総半島・能登半島から沖縄。

A slender snail about 3 to 4 cm long that inhabits sandy and muddy tidal flats. The shell of this snail is one of the ingredients used to make “nerikō”—a type of incense made by blending various fragrances—and is written in kanji as “Kōkō.” Found from the Bōsō and Noto Peninsulas to Okinawa.

和名：甲香

英名：Pirenella nipponica

学名：*Pirenella nipponica* Ozawa & Reid in Reid & Ozawa, 2016　キバウミニナ科　Potamididae

殻長：2.2㎝

参考文献：「貝の疑問50」編著　日本貝類学会　成山堂書店

name: Sketchy Sardine
description:
A fun little personal project I set for myself. Roughly modeled off of a sardine but with a great deal of creative liberties.
I specifically wanted to challenge myself to do unlit textures and experiment with style and colour. The hand-drawn 'mess crayon style' was a lot more challenging than I anticipated. It was really difficult adding texture and detail using only colour and without using normals and roughness. I've also wanted to incorporate more details using single planes into my work, since I'm still very much learning when it comes to alpha maps, which is something I need to get a good grasp on if i want to work towards higher detail models. 
***Modelled in Maya, Textured in Substance Painter.*

name: "The Blush Sentinel”
description:
A surreal fusion of dog and sheep, this bright pink creature blends playful polymer-clay craft with the gleam of glazed porcelain. Its bulbous curls, exaggerated ears, and drooping tongue give it a quirky yet regal stance—like a guardian from a dream. The glossy surface catches light in soft candy tones, balancing whimsy with a hint of the uncanny.

In local legend, “The Blush Sentinel” was said to watch over pasture gates in the in-between world, warding off mischief by distracting intruders with its comical face. Those who laughed at it found themselves lost in pleasant fields for days, until they truly wished to return.

Originally sculpted in polymer clay, then 3D scanned and auto-textured, this model is fully optimized and game-ready. Suitable for stylized worlds, surreal games, or digital collectibles.

Terrestrial Dinosaur Project A to Z

> This is part of my personal challenge: recreating all 326 dinosaurs featured in the official list of the Natural History Museum (London). >

name: Fox Plushy
description:
My goal for this model was to create a game ready low poly asset, keeping the silhoutte while retaining as much of the details in the texture.

Started off as a high poly scan using the Artec Spider 3D scanner and processed in Artec Studio software and used Houdini to align, center and ground to the world origin planes.

I then took it into Maya to retopologize and optimize it into its final low poly form. Used Substance Designer to bake the diffuse map from the scan mesh. Then took it to Substance Painter to bake the normal map, after that was a lot of manual cleanup for the diffuse and normals as well as adding in lost details and a roughness map to get it as close to a plush fabric material for the final look.  

No AI was used.

name: Садиба Суханових-Сумовських. м. Суми
description:
Садиба Суханових-Сумовських — один із найцікавіших історичних комплексів Сум. Збудована у 1895 році, вона збереглася не як окремий будинок, а як ціла садиба: головний особняк, контора власника, службові приміщення та наріжний корпус. Колись комплекс займав майже квартал, а позаду простягався великий сад до сучасної Покровської вулиці. Нині на його місці розташований Конгрес-центр СумДУ.

Спершу садиба належала родині Суханових, згодом — Сумовським. Пізніше комплекс поділили між різними формами власності, і він утратив цілісність маєтку. З 1991 року тут працює Інститут прикладної фізики НАН України.

13 квітня 2025 року садиба зазнала значних пошкоджень унаслідок ракетного удару російських військ. Сьогодні її стан критично впливає на збереження пам’ятки.

В історико-архітектурному опорному плані Сум комплекс названо яскравим ансамблем Петропавлівської вулиці, що додає середовищу палацової пишноти й вишуканості.

name: 3" Alumawood Panels w/ Fan Beam & Fans
description:
This model shows a set of 3" Alumawood™ insulated roof panels, including two fan-beam panels designed to support ceiling fans. The assembly is intentionally displayed as a floating, exploded visualization to clearly show the relationship between the top skin, EPS foam core, bottom skin, and the 1" × 3" fan-beam chase that runs through the insulated panel.

Two example ceiling fans are included beneath the structure to demonstrate how a fan-beam allows a fan to mount securely without compromising the panel or foam core. This is a technical representation only—not a full installation guide—and the fans shown are strictly for visual context.

Use this model to better understand how Alumawood insulated roof panels integrate fan-beam openings for electrical wiring and fan support.

For more models, diagrams, and technical guides:

name: Palm Oil Factory – Complete Extraction Line
description:
This 3D model represents a small-scale palm oil mill plant (1–5 tons per hour capacity), designed to illustrate the complete workflow of palm oil production from fresh fruit bunches (FFB) to crude palm oil (CPO).

The model includes key processing units typically found in a standard palm oil extraction line, such as:

* Sterilization system (steam treatment)
* Threshing unit (fruit separation)
* Digestion and screw press system
* Oil clarification and filtration process

This setup is commonly used for small to medium industrial operations, offering an efficient and compact solution for palm oil processing.

🔧 Purpose:

* Educational and engineering reference

name: Capital of San Juan de la Peña – The Last Supper
description: This model is based on the Last Supper capital from the Monastery of San Juan de la Peña, one of the most representative examples of Romanesque sculpture in this important Aragonese monumental complex. Carved in stone during the 12th century, it depicts the moment when Jesus Christ shares the Last Supper with his twelve apostles before his Passion. The scene is distinguished by the simplicity of its forms, a characteristic feature of Romanesque art. In the capital, Christ occupies the central position, with the apostles seated on either side of the table. Beyond their artistic value, Romanesque capitals also served a didactic purpose at a time when much of the population was unable to read. Overall, the Last Supper capital is an outstanding example of Spanish Romanesque sculpture, in which religious symbolism takes precedence over realism. name: The Former Toowong Library
description:
The Former Toowong Library
579–583 Coronation Dr, Toowong, Qld, 4066, Australia.

Date opened: April 13, 1961
Original Use: Public Library
Closed: 2001
Current use: Private commercial building

Architect: James P. Birrell (1928-2019)

The former Toowong Library is a State Heritage listed building in Queensland from its modern, post-war era. It was designed by nationally recognised architect James 'Jim' Birrell. This model is based on the Library as it were in 1961 which is considered to be the height of its architectural significance. The auditorium itself has been drawn on plan and elevations but lacks the detailed drawings of the room which was instead creatively interpreted using references from Birrell's other works and features within the library itself. The main Library space and the playground area are modelled after contemporaneous photos whereas the sorting room is modelled after detailed plans and present day photos to recreate the joinery.

Modelled by Pio Gillamac III

The Nürburgring Grand Prix (GP) circuit is a modern, FIA Grade 1 motorsports facility located in Nürburg, Germany. Constructed in 1984 and redesigned by Hermann Tilke in 2002, the 5.148 km (3.199 miles) circuit features 16 to 17 technical turns and hosts major racing series like DTM and GT Masters.

The track was completed in 1984 and named GP-Strecke (German: Großer Preis-Strecke: literally, "Grand Prix Course"). It was built to meet the highest safety standards. However, it was considered in character a mere shadow of its older sibling. Some fans, who had to sit much farther away from the track, called it Eifelring, Ersatzring, Grünering or similar nicknames, believing it did not deserve to be called Nürburgring. Like many circuits of the time, it offered few overtaking opportunities.

name: Kitchen - Einscan Trak
description:
## Scanning
Scanning was done at 1,5mm target point distance with two tracker positions (first side of the kitchen, then second side). No preparation was done on the shiny sink or coffee maker. I just started scanning after making sure the tracking volume covers what I needed.  
The scans itself took roughly 7min per piece. I used remote desktop from my tablet to see what I already scanned (hope they will bring a quick action to show ortho view of the whole scan at some point. Local view is already there but I need the exact opposite). Scan itself was very smooth with a constant 90FPS, when approaching the fringes of the tracking volume it becomes slower before loosing tracking.

## Post-Processing
Processing was quite simple: Point cloud generation isn't needed on the Trak so I could directly go to aligning the two scans with automatic feature alignment and then meshing in default settings. Mesh came out to roughly 20M triangles, I aligned and reduced it to 4M in Quicksurface.

name: Kultura3D - The Hansen Pavilions, LSM, Lublin
description:
The Hansen Pavilions located within the LSM estate are among the most distinctive examples of post-war modernist architecture in Lublin, Poland. Designed as part of the visionary urban planning concepts of architect Oskar Hansen, they formed an integral element of a residential district created around the principles of functionality, accessibility, and community life.
Hansen, known for his influential theory of Open Form, believed that architecture should support human activity rather than impose rigid solutions. The pavilions were intended to serve everyday needs by providing space for shops, services, and social interaction within walking distance of residents.
Today, these structures remain valuable witnesses to the architectural and social ideas of the 20th century. Their simple geometric forms and practical design reflect a period when urban planning sought to create living environments centered on people and their daily experiences.

name: Laocoonte
description:
Modello 3D digitale ispirato al celebre Gruppo del Laocoonte, uno dei massimi capolavori della scultura ellenistica (I secolo d.C.), custodito presso i Musei Vaticani.

Questo modello è stato realizzato come progetto didattico per il Liceo, con l'obiettivo di unire lo studio della storia dell'arte antica con le moderne tecnologie di modellazione e ottimizzazione tridimensionale. L'opera originale rappresenta il drammatico momento in cui il sacerdote troiano Laocoonte e i suoi figli vengono aggrediti dai serpenti marini, inviati dagli dei per impedire che venisse svelato l'inganno del Cavallo di Troia.

Il focus del progetto è stato ricreare la forte tensione anatomica, il dinamismo delle linee diagonali e il profondo pathos (sofferenza) che caratterizzano lo stile barocco-ellenistico.
Software utilizzato: Blender (Modellazione, Sculpting e Lighting).

Topologia: Mesh ottimizzata per la visualizzazione in tempo reale su Sketchfab tramite corretta gestione del baking delle normali.

name: I. Jesús es condenado a muerte
description:
**Modelo 3D que representa el momento en que Jesús es condenado a muerte por Poncio Pilato, marcando el inicio del recorrido del Vía Crucis.** La pieza busca transmitir la solemnidad y trascendencia de este acontecimiento, destacando el contraste entre la autoridad que dicta la sentencia y la serenidad con la que Jesús la acepta. 

La composición enfatiza la tensión narrativa del juicio y el comienzo del camino hacia el sacrificio. El modelado 3D resalta la interacción entre los personajes, sus posturas y expresiones, reforzando el significado simbólico de la escena como el punto de partida de la pasión de Cristo y uno de los momentos más representativos de la tradición cristiana.

name: Pfarrkirche Hl. Bartholomäus
description: The parish church of St. Bartholomew stands on the church hill in Katzelsdorf in the market town of Bernhardsthal. It was built between 1905 and 1908 and was designed by architect Karl Weinbrenner. It was built to mark the 50th anniversary of the Liechtenstein family's reign and replaced an older Gothic church that had been rebuilt several times. The new building is in a historicist style that combines elements of Neo-Romanesque and Neo-Gothic architecture. Characteristic features include the brick façade, buttresses, and pointed arch windows, which together with the high tower with its pointed spire characterize the exterior appearance. The church is divided into a nave and a transept with a polygonal choir and is visible from afar due to its elevated position. This makes it a striking landmark in the townscape and underlines the historical significance of the church for Katzelsdorf and the surrounding area.

La Torre del Fraile (Algeciras) forma parte del programa defensivo impulsado por Felipe II en el siglo XVI. Se trata de un singular ejemplo del modelo campogibraltareño de torre almenara, de planta cuadrangular, construida dentro del sistema de vigilancia costera.

Estado de conservación de la Torre del Fraile en mayo de 2019.

name: Ovsyannikov house
description:
The house of the directors of the Myronivka Sugar Factory is one of the oldest surviving buildings in Myronivka. It was built in the second half of the 19th century, following the establishment of the sugar factory, and at the beginning of the 20th century it became the home of Mykola and Cecilia Ovsyannikova. Their activities left a significant mark on the history of the city. They supported the development of education and financed the construction of a girls’ parish school, while Cecilia Ovsyannikova devoted herself to educating children and establishing a public library. At the couple’s initiative, the local mineral springs were studied, and their therapeutic properties laid the foundation for the development of balneology in Myronivka. 
Today, the building is an important architectural landmark and a reminder of Myronivka’s industrial, educational, and medical heritage.

name: Постоялый двор   1787-1789гг .Спасский монастырь
description:
Здание   Спасского монастыря  (постоялый двор-место для ночлега путешественников. )  в городе Симбирске -Ульяновске . Годы постройки 1787-1789   .Дом распологается на перекрестке улицы Бебеля( бывш Чебоксарская)  и Пожарном переулке (бывш Полицейский переулок) . 
Стена из красного кирпича была построена ещё в конце XVIII века и была белой ,но уже в конце  XIX  века из- за обветшалости  была реконструирована полностью, она проходила  по улице Бебеля(Чебоксарской) вдоль современного ДГ Губернатроский.  На сегодняшний день остался лишь один пролёт  стены ,как показано на фотографии. Было добавлено ещё несколько пролётов стены , что бы вы смогли увидеть как она выглядела полностью.
На заднем дворе были  бревенчатые хозяйственные  постройки относящиеся к периоду  XIX века они не сохранились.

name: Transformers Fall Of Cybertron Soundwave
description: Soundwave estuvo presente cuando Starscream y Onslaught llevaron a Optimus ante Megatron . Observó cómo Metroplex pulverizaba a Megatron. Fue el único que dudó en seguir a Starscream. En secreto, rescató a Optimus y, con la ayuda de Laserbeak, Rumble y un TechVolt de la EDK , reconstruyó a su glorioso líder, mejorando su diseño original. Infundió a Megatron con Energon Oscuro y lo dirigió hacia Starscream. Participó en el asalto a la fábrica que los Autobots habían construido en el cráter donde se estrelló Trypticon, y una vez que Megatron reconstruyó al Decepticon gigante, acudió a activar el núcleo de energía de Trypticon.
